# Nosana

Nosana is an open-source GPU cloud for AI inference and other high-performance
workloads. You rent GPU capacity on demand from a distributed network of
providers, or contribute idle GPUs and earn for running other people's
workloads. Everything a person can do in the dashboard is also available over a
public HTTP API, a TypeScript SDK, and an agent skill.

## When to use Nosana

Reach for Nosana when a job needs a GPU that the calling machine does not have:

- **Serving an open-weights model.** Deploy vLLM, Ollama or llama.cpp behind an
  HTTPS endpoint and call it like any other inference API.
- **Long-running GPU services.** A deployment keeps replicas running and
  replaces them when a host drops, so it suits a service rather than a one-shot
  script.
- **Batch GPU work.** Rendering, simulation, fine-tuning, benchmarking — a job
  runs a container image on a GPU and exits.
- **Agents that need to provision compute themselves.** The API is
  key-authenticated and scriptable, so an agent can pick a market, deploy, poll
  for readiness and tear down without a human in the loop.

Nosana is **not** the right tool for CPU-only batch work, general web hosting,
persistent databases, or anything needing stable storage between runs — a
deployment's filesystem does not survive it.

How an agent should call it: authenticate with an API key or a Nosana Connect
OAuth token, choose a market with `GET /api/markets/`, create a deployment with
`POST /api/deployments/create`, start it, then poll the endpoint URL until it
answers. A job reported as `RUNNING` has been placed on a host, which is not
the same as its container serving traffic — poll the endpoint, not the job
state.

## Programmatic access

- [OpenAPI 3.1 document](https://api.nosana.com/api/openapi.json) — every public
  endpoint across deployments, jobs, markets, credits and nodes
- [API reference](https://api.nosana.com/api/docs) — the same document, browsable
- [Authentication walkthrough for agents](https://nosana.com/auth.md)
- [Pricing, machine-readable](https://nosana.com/pricing.md)
- [Agent skill index](https://nosana.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [Agentic resource catalog](https://nosana.com/.well-known/ard.json)
- [nosana-kit on GitHub](https://github.com/nosana-ci/nosana-kit) — TypeScript
  SDK, agent skill and API clients
